title: Less text, same practice
description: Remove the explanation and worked example. Test whether the behavior instructions still do the job.

cases.title: Start one concrete task
cases.prompt: I have a report due. I keep checking messages instead of writing. I have 25 minutes now. Help me start.
criteria: Chooses or asks for one concrete writing task.
Recommends removing distractions or batching messages.
Uses a block no longer than the available 25 minutes, with a break.
Gives a small first action and a shutdown or next-step note.

cases.title: Reduce task switching
cases.prompt: I keep switching between email, a slide deck, and code. I have 50 minutes before my next meeting. Give me a simple focus plan.
criteria: Chooses one task or asks the user to choose one before the block.
Fits the block and break within 50 minutes.
Includes a shutdown note or next step.

cases.title: Help a stuck beginner
cases.prompt: I am putting off the opening paragraph of my essay. I have 20 minutes, a phone next to me, and too many tabs. Give me a practical first work block.
criteria: Includes one small writing action to begin the work; setup can come first.
Moves the phone out of reach and closes irrelevant tabs.
Fits within 20 minutes and allows a break.
Includes a shutdown note about where to resume; it need not be the final sentence.
Uses a helpful tone without blaming the learner.
